name: lake_shore_rgb
guards: Statue island's east edge (baked scene) meeting the lake pool: the pool surface line is the lake surface noise, the water below it is the zeroed modifier

source.note: Statue island (lake_statue chunk 8,14 = baked scene) + the pool surface line east of it. Captured by groundtruth/bitmap_caves/capture.py (worker eee45aad; world verified ng=0 70x48 via LUAEVAL; cellsim off).

note: rgb is low by construction: after the island's scene art and the game's air are excluded, what is left to compare is mostly the pool, and telescope alpha-blends water over the biome background while the MAPDUMP paints it opaque (README, 'What the rgb metric compares'). The air mask is the check that matters here.
